title: potentilla phyllocalyx subsp. dryadanthoides
intro: Potentilla phyllocalyx subsp. dryadanthoides, commonly known as a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae, is a type of cinquefoil. It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla phyllocalyx subsp. dryadanthoides include wound healing, antiseptic, and antifungal activities, making it useful in treating various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
